intelligence.human_view: Think of it like two people reaching for the same parking space. You look, the space is empty, you turn the wheel — and in that second, another car pulls in. Looking once is not enough; you have to look again after you park. The guard looks once. Now the loop looks twice: once before filing, once after — and if the second look finds a collision, the later car moves, the same hour, no waiting.
intelligence.simple_view: The guard says "this number is free!" — but another friend can take it one minute later! So now we check TWICE — once before we file, and once after! If someone took our number in between, we move to a new number right away!
intelligence.grandma_view: It's like this, love — the guard says the number is free, dear, but another little car can slip in one minute later! So now we check twice, love — once before, and once after! And if someone took our number, dear, we move to a new one right away, no waiting!
intelligence.naya_view: Re-run the guard after every filing batch. The guard's blessing is an instant: it reads the live tree and prints the next free number, but another lane can file that number before your PUT lands. The per-path 404 pre-check cannot catch a same-number file in another category. After the PUTs verify, run the guard again — a batch is done only when the post-filing guard runs clean. If it reports a duplicate, the later filing moves the same run: take the next free number, file at the new path, update any paired note in place, delete the old capture, verify 404, and re-run the guard until it is clean. Never leave a duplicate standing for the next run — two notes sharing a number break the feed and the distillation machine, and the breakage compounds every hour it stands.
